correctness.rationale: Rebuilt GP(6,2) with 18 graph edges from package definitions and enumerated all 4095 nonempty 12-vertex masks: exactly 170 independent faces, f=(12,48,74,36); 36 maximal independent sets all have size four. Exhausting all 924 six-sets found precisely 18 inducing three disjoint edges, each giving the octahedron S0*S0*S0. Independently retrieved complete octahedral_spines.json by verified Git blob fc08941ad6920caf397fd5d4a851018cb94be705 and reimplemented certificate checking: for every one of 18 cores, all 72 ordered lower/upper pairs are contained in the current K, lower has exactly one strict remaining coface upper, both are outside the target K[W], and after 72 collapses only the 26 included target nonempty faces remain. All 1,296 free-face pairs passed. Since ordinary elementary collapses preserve homotopy, K collapses to S² and has reduced H2=Z; orbit-size 6/12 follows from D6 graph automorphisms (outer hexagon and spokes distinguish full group), and the signed augmented simplicial Lefschetz trace of r^a s^b is (-1)^(a+b), compatible with the source verifier and homology one-dimensionality. Purity dim3 with nonzero H2 rules out Cohen-Macaulayness in every field and pure shellability. The independent certificate check proves exactly the asserted finite collapses, not a general family classification.
